Both columns return the same results, but 'Margin Health Score (Unoptimized)' repeats the DIVIDE/SUM logic three times inside nested IFs — each repetition re-evaluates the same filter context.

'Margin Health Score' computes Gross Margin % once as a variable and branches from the trusted base measure using SWITCH(TRUE(), ...). This is easier to read, test, and maintain, and avoids redundant evaluation.

Use Performance Analyzer or DAX Studio (Verify for Gov) to compare query duration between the two patterns on a large model.
